To whom it may concern,

This submission serves to explain the reasons behind the delay in the WebTrust Assurance Reports for the Electronic Transactions Development Agency (ETDA) for the audit period from September 2024 to January 2025.

As per Mozilla's Root Store Policy requirements, we are obligated to submit the WebTrust Assurance Reports by the stipulated deadlines. However, due to unforeseen circumstances, we encountered delays in the audit process. Specifically, we faced challenges in finalizing our work within the expected timeline, as outlined in the explanatory letter from BDO Malaysia dated April 10, 2026.

The letter details that the delay was primarily due to the transition of our WebTrust Practitioner’s License from our previous entity to BDO, which required additional time to ensure compliance with quality standards and relevant professional obligations. We have made every effort to mitigate these delays and are committed to providing the necessary documentation as soon as possible.

We appreciate your understanding and are prepared to provide any further information or clarification you may require regarding this matter.

Thank you for your attention to this issue.

Best regards,
Surasak Sata
ETDA-THNRCA
